name: Shiretoko
blurb: Sea ice feeds plankton, plankton feeds salmon, and salmon feed bears and fish owls.

tip.title: Melt the sea ice
tip.text: Drift ice releases nutrients that start the plankton bloom. Set Drift sea ice to -100% and watch plankton, then fish, sea lions and eagles.

notes: The species list comes from GBIF occurrence records inside a circle around the park, so it can include nearby areas. Feeding links come from GloBI records and the sources listed where they state them; others are general ecology and are illustrative.

nodes.desc: Soil of the peninsula forests and meadows, enriched by decaying plants and by animals that die or leave remains on land.

nodes.name: Decomposers
nodes.desc: Fungi and bacteria that break down dead plants, carcasses and spent salmon, returning nutrients to soil.

nodes.name: Sea ice algae and phytoplankton
nodes.desc: Microscopic algae that bloom in spring when sea ice melts and nutrients rise. They are the base of the marine food web.
A low berry shrub of cool northern ground. Its berries are eaten by brown bears, red foxes and voles.
A common grazer and browser of the peninsula, eating grasses and dwarf bamboo. Winter deer carcasses feed eagles, crows and bears.

nodes.name: Gray red-backed vole
nodes.desc: A small rodent of forest and scrub that eats berries and other plant matter. It is prey for foxes, owls and raptors.

nodes.name: Pink and chum salmon
nodes.desc: Feed at sea on plankton and small animals, then return to spawn in the rivers. Their run carries ocean nutrients to bears, owls and the forest.
Winters and springs at haul-outs around Hokkaido. It eats pollock, cod, salmon and squid.
An opportunistic hunter and scavenger that takes voles, birds and berries.
A bold scavenger that feeds on carrion, fish remains and plant foods.
A huge eagle that winters on the Okhotsk coast. It eats mainly pollock and cod and readily scavenges carrion such as deer carcasses.

nodes.name: Hokkaido brown bear
nodes.desc: The peninsula holds Japan's densest bear population. It eats berries, acorns, deer and spawning salmon, and carries salmon nutrients into the forest.
Hunts in the cold waters off the peninsula; recorded prey include sea lions, seals and porpoises.
